results.headline: BofA Double Upgrades Air Liquide to Buy Amid Record Electronics Backlog; Price Objective, Forecasts Up

chunks.text:
05:41 AM EDT, 07/02/2026 (MT Newswires) -- BofA Global Research double-upgraded Air Liquide (AI.PA) to buy from underperform, noting the industrial gas company's record backlog in electronics.
"Air Liquide is the number one supplier of gases used in the semiconductor manufacturing process such as high purity nitrogen and noble gases. Our analysis concludes that the Electronics franchise is set to organically grow at c14% through 2026-30E, effectively double the rate in consensus," analysts wrote in a Wednesday note. "We therefore see Electronics becoming an increasingly important contributor, driving c40% of our estimated 4.5% group organic growth in FY'27E and expect it also to be margin accretive."
Looking ahead, the research firm said its EBIT projections for 2028 to 2030 are above the Visible Alpha-compiled consensus by 2%, 4%, and 5%, respectively. "Given the multi-year nature of fab construction, the benefit from Electronics backlog will become more apparent in later years," BofA added.
The stock's price objective increased to 200 euros from 159 euros, as EPS forecasts for 2026 to 2028 rose to reflect the 1-for-10 free share attribution.

results.headline: BofA Forecasts 'Strong' Airbus Q2 Results on Expected Higher Deliveries, Steady Mix

chunks.text:
05:14 AM EDT, 07/02/2026 (MT Newswires) -- BofA Global Research forecasts Airbus (AIR.PA, AIR.F) will deliver a solid second-quarter performance due to expectations of improved delivery volumes and a steady mix.
"We expect a strong 2Q result. We forecast 215-220 deliveries, a substantial increase from c.170 aircraft in 2Q25, reflecting improved industrial execution and a healthier supply-chain environment. The mix between A321 and A320 aircraft appears broadly stable year-on-year, which should allow investors to better assess the [drop-through] on higher volumes. Airbus has previously suggested around EUR15m of incremental EBIT for every additional aircraft delivered, although we think A320/321 is likely higher than this," analysts said in a Wednesday earnings preview report.

results.headline: Clearwater Paper's Earnings Progress Likely Limited by Market Oversupply, BofA Says

chunks.text:
11:02 AM EDT, 07/02/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Clearwater Paper (CLW) earnings growth is likely to remain "limited" by persistent "oversupply" in the solid bleached sulfate, or SBS market, with weak supply-demand fundamentals expected to continue weighing on pricing and margins, BofA Securities said in a report Thursday.
Clearwater's "transformation into a pure-play" SBS producer following its tissue business exit and the Augusta mill acquisition simplifies its business, but the company remains exposed to a "challenged industry backdrop" and limited near-term catalysts, the report said.
About 500,000 tons of new SBS capacity added in the second half of 2025 has kept the market oversupplied, while announced capacity closures remain insufficient to restore balance, according to the report. The firm also expects the company's free cash flow to fall below management's guidance.
BofA initiated coverage of Clearwater Paper with a neutral rating and a $19 price target, adding the shares appear fairly valued given forecast risks and leverage concerns.

results.headline: BofA Keeps Rexel at Buy Amid Expectations of Stronger Pricing in Q2

chunks.text:
07:51 AM EDT, 07/02/2026 (MT Newswires) -- BofA Global Research on Wednesday reiterated its buy rating on Rexel (RXL.PA), expecting its investment thesis to be validated when the company releases its first-half results on July 28.
For its second quarter, the French electrical products and services distributor is anticipated to report a 5.6% annual growth in organic sales on a same-day basis, with soft volumes offset by stronger pricing.
"We expect pricing realisation to accelerate, with both cable and non-cable inflecting on higher-than-expected copper prices and OEM price increases," analysts said. "We continue to see Rexel as an underestimated story beyond short-term pricing momentum. We think the earnings mix is becoming increasingly tilted towards North America, which should translate into higher-quality earnings."
Meanwhile, analysts forecast Rexel's first-half adjusted EBITA margin to come in at 6.2%, slightly higher than the Visible Alpha consensus of 6.1%.
The price objective for the stock was left unchanged at 45 euros.
